en.explanation:
(A) Alkyl chloride reacts with H2/Pd-BaSO4 and reduced to alkyl aldehyde. This is known as Rosenmund reduction.

(B) Carboxylic acid reacts with Cl2/P in aqueous medium to form 2-chlorocarboxylic acid. This reaction is known as HVZ reaction.

(C) Alkyl amide reacts with Br2 in presence of NaOH to give alkyl amine. This reaction is known as Hofmann bromide reaction,

(D) Ketone reacts with Zn-Hg in presence of conc.HCl to give alkane. This reaction is known as Clemmensen reduction.

Hence, correct match is (A)-2, (B)-4, (C)-1, (D)-3.
